fields.contract: MapToSql*Attribute is the SQL Server family of property- and collection-mapping attributes. Scalar property attributes derive from SqlParameterMapAttribute : ParameterMapAttributeBase; each fixes one SqlDbType target and accepts a logical parameter-or-column name plus optional isRequired (string and binary variants also retain Length, ANSI text variants retain LocaleId, and Decimal retains Precision and Scale). Each scalar variant validates candidate CLR types and contributes expressions for input parameters, output parameters, output-value reads, data-reader reads, and table-valued-parameter (TVP) rows (except MapToSqlJsonAttribute, whose AppendTvpExpressions throws NotImplementedException). Integer mappings support unchecked same-width conversions for non-native CLR integer types: ulong and ulong? on MapToSqlBigIntAttribute, uint and uint? on MapToSqlIntAttribute, ushort and ushort? on MapToSqlSmallIntAttribute, and sbyte and sbyte? on MapToSqlTinyIntAttribute. Enum support: MapToSqlIntAttribute, MapToSqlSmallIntAttribute, and MapToSqlTinyIntAttribute accept any enum or Nullable<enum> regardless of underlying integer type; MapToSqlBigIntAttribute accepts any non-nullable enum and rejects Nullable<enum>. Binary numeric mappings: MapToSqlBinaryAttribute and MapToSqlVarBinaryAttribute support byte[] as well as fixed-width big-endian binary encoding (8, 4, 2, and 1 bytes via NumericBinaryConverter) for ulong, uint, ushort, and sbyte (and their nullable forms) across input parameters, output parameters, data readers (ReaderBinaryNumericExpressions), and TVPs. MapToSqlBinaryAttribute.IsValidType and MapToSqlVarBinaryAttribute.IsValidType invoke the shared IsValidBinaryType validator for recognized numeric types and throw InvalidBinaryMappingLengthException (when Binary.Length != width or VarBinary.Length is neither -1 nor in width..8000) before returning true, while returning false (causing Mapper to throw InvalidMapTypeException) for unsupported CLR types; at runtime, reader and output-parameter decoders throw InvalidBinaryValueLengthException when a non-null byte[] payload length differs from width. Collection mapping: MapToSqlTableValuedParameterAttribute : CollectionMapAttributeBase(string parameterName, string typeName) maps a collection property (such as IEnumerable<T>, List<T>, or ImmutableArray<T>, normalizing default ImmutableArray<T> to Empty) to a SQL Server table-valued input parameter with SqlParameter.TypeName = TypeName and hydrates child result sets on reads. Note: ShardKey binary/UTF-8 serialization does not support ulong, uint, ushort, or sbyte record/child key components.
